'''Doda Bodonawieedo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[slitherhorn]] ([[traz]]) player for the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]]. He was also an information broker and was a part of the [[Shawpee Gang|Shawpee street gang]].

==Biography==
[[File:DodaBodonawieedoBarquinDan-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|250px|Bodonawieedo and [[Barquin D'an/Legends|Barquin D'an]] performing "[[Jedi Rocks/Legends|Jedi Rocks]]"]]
As members of the [[Tetsu Clan]], Doda's parents were forced to flee [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] following their clan's declaration of extermination by the Rodian [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]]. Five [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after his parent's exodus, Doda was born on a transport shuttle bound for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. His family settled in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and opened a small laundry shop in the city's [[Old Quarter/Legends|old quarter]]. Doda grew up in the streets of Mos Eisley where he met a [[Human/Legends|human]] boy named [[Falk (criminal)|Falk]]. The mischievous boy would rope Doda into plots to steal [[Ronto barbecue steak]]s from street vendors and to [[Frocking|frock]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas.]]<ref name="SE" /> 

When Doda was ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] killed his parents and burnt down their laundry shop home. Since Doda was born offworld after the Testsu Clan extermination order was decreed, his name was not on the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] so the hunter spared him. The newly orphaned Doda plunged into a life of petty street crime, becoming one of the founding members of the [[Shawpee Gang|Shawpee street gang]] alongside his friend Falk.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>  As the Shawpee gang members grew older and formed ties with the Mos Eisley underworld, Doda distanced himself from their criminal activities and became a [[Musician/Legends|minstrel]]. While Doda's mother had taught him to hate Rodian culture, his father had trained him in several classical Rodian musical instruments. His music skills landed him many gigs, including [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.]]<ref name="SE" /> 

Doda and Falk eventually decided to leave the Shawpee Gang to seek greater fortunes in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] operation. Doda became the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean guard's]] favorite [[Bard (title)|bard]] and played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with the palace servants.<ref name="DB" /> Falk meanwhile worked as one of [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna's]] runners and was executed when he was caught eavesdropping. Doda was nearly punished because of his close association with Falk, but fellow Tetsu Clan Rodian [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] spoke on his behalf. Bib Fortuna replaced Falk with Doda and employed him as his runner when we wasn't performing. Jabba assigned Doda to play with the various bands that performed in the palace to keep an eye on them. When the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] arrived, Doda developed a strong camaraderie with its members, much to Jabba's displeasure. Doda was immediately entranced when he first saw [[Greeata Jendowanian/Legends|Greeata Jendowanian]], but the female Rodian was not interested and gently let him down. Hours before Jabba sailed off on his doomed trip to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], Bib Fortuna sent Doda to Mos Eisley to deliver a love-letter to his mistress [[Onici Wen]]. After hearing of Jabba's death, he stole several priceless sculptures from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Desilijic Complex/Legends|town house]] and fled the planet. Among these statues were the [[Minstrel]] and the [[Dancing Goddess/Legends|Dancing Goddesses]], which he sold back to the [[Godoan/Legends|people]] of [[Godo]] for an obscene price. He then sold the rest of the sculptures to an art collector on [[Tharkos]] and made a new life for himself on another world with the wealth.<ref name="WW">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Bodonawieedo disliked traditional Rodian culture growing up, yet he had affinity for classical Rodian music. The Rodian had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin, black eyes, and stood at 1.6 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="DB" /> Most who knew Doda quickly grew fond of his gentle and witty demeanor.<ref name="WW" /> 

==Skills and abilities==
Bodonawieedo was a skilled player of wind instruments.<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doda was added to the extended musical number in the Special Edition of ''Return of the Jedi''. He was portrayed by an uncredited [[Nelson Hall]]. Doda was made into an action figure in 1998.
